spans.s:
1. पीथ, अस्, m. (for 2. and 3. see p. 578, col. 1), a
drink, draught [cf. गो-प्˚]; (अम्), n. water; melted
butter.

3. पीथ, अस्, m. the sun; fire; time. (For 1.
and 2. पीथ see p. 577, col. 2, and above.)

पीथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) drinking;
कोश-प्˚, squandering away the treasury.
पीथ्य पीथ्य. See under 2. पीति above.
पीथि पीथि, इस्, m. See under 3. पीति above.

पीथे पीथे, m., N. of a chief builder (in
an inscription).
